title: Grill and oven cooking
brief_description: A comprehensive survey of all things dealing with the art of grilling and oven cooking of a variety of foods. Includes hints on cakes, pies and pastry. No 4 of a Cookery Series suitable for women’s groups and domestic-science classes.
